releaseNotes: Note PIN lock setup and unlock proceed automatically after four digits. Turning Lock Off now removes the lock immediately after the correct PIN, without an extra OK confirmation. Existing notes, photos, PIN data, and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Note Lock Forgot PIN now shows the temporary recovery PIN, then automatically opens the new 4-digit PIN and confirmation steps. Both PIN fields submit automatically after four digits; no extra OK button. Existing notes and photos are preserved.
